description: This file defines the BidiFirefox class, a specialized BrowserType for Firefox in Playwright's server bidi implementation. It includes methods for connecting, environment setup, graceful shutdown, and configuration specific to Firefox.

classes.name: BidiFirefox
classes.description: A BrowserType subclass for Firefox, handling connection, environment setup, and shutdown procedures specific to Firefox in Playwright.

methods.name: executablePath
methods.description: Returns an empty string, indicating no specific executable path is set.

methods.name: connectToTransport
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the browser via transport and options.

methods.name: doRewriteStartupLog
methods.description: Rewrites startup logs to include user-friendly messages for common errors.

methods.name: amendEnvironment
methods.description: Modifies environment variables for Firefox launch, ensuring correct paths and removing conflicting variables.

methods.name: attemptToGracefullyCloseBrowser
methods.description: Initiates a graceful shutdown of the browser session.

methods.name: _attemptToGracefullyCloseBrowser
methods.description: Internal method to send shutdown commands over transport.

methods.name: supportsPipeTransport
methods.description: Indicates whether pipe transport is supported (returns false).

methods.name: prepareUserDataDir
methods.description: Prepares the user data directory with Firefox preferences.

methods.name: defaultArgs
methods.description: Generates default command-line arguments for launching Firefox.

methods.name: waitForReadyState
methods.description: Waits for the browser to be ready, resolving with WebSocket endpoint info.
